title: Harmony House | 9 Min to BDWY, Rooftop Patio
description:
Welcome to The Harmony House, the perfect spot for bachelorette parties and group getaways in Nashville! This 4-bedroom home sleeps 10, featuring a king bed, 2 queen beds, and 2 bunk beds. Enjoy a rooftop terrace with downtown views, a game room with arcade and beer pong table, and a fully stocked kitchen for group meals. Located minutes from Broadway’s nightlife, this stylish retreat offers the ultimate mix of fun and relaxation. Book now and make your Nashville trip unforgettable!

The space
Parking Info:

To enhance your Nashville experience, we converted our garage into a unique entertainment space—complete with a mini stage, arcade games, disco lights, a silent disco setup, and a comfy lounge seating area for your group. So it’s not available for parking.

There’s plenty of guest parking in the complex, but it can fill up quickly on weekends. We recommend arriving early or planning ahead just in case.

If you're visiting Nashville, Uber or Lyft is the way to go! We're super central—just a short drive from Broadway and Music Row. Rideshares are quick, affordable, and save you the hassle of finding parking.
